fato_historico: 1844: The Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, headed by Brigham Young, is reaffirmed as the leading body of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (LDS Church).
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to solidify your inner circle and honor those who walk by your side. Just as collective leadership once found a steady path forward, you may find that aligning with your trusted companions strengthens your emotional security. It is a good time to embrace the roots that anchor your beautiful and sensitive heart.
frase_do_dia: Strong foundations allow your soul to bloom under the brightest summer sun.
significado_numero: Represents completeness and the strength found in collaborative community bonds.
conselho: Consider hosting a small gathering to share warmth and cultivate deeper emotional connections.
